title: A rerun of failed jobs reuses the PR's cached merge ref, so a PR queued behind a red main stays red after main's fix lands
why: Owner fb-2343-2 (Nov 15 23:43 CST) asked whether this degen feedback is right: a rerun of failed jobs reuses the PR's cached merge ref; fix: ci-hygiene says rerun only when the base did not move, otherwise close and reopen (or push); the merge tool can check the run's base sha against main before rerunning.
source: Consultant message to triage 9, 17:50 CST Nov 16 (owner messages relayed word for word; checked by two read-only agents, sonnet, 17:56 CST; not read by triage 9). Filed by triage 9.
